title: Claude Code — Team Retro (aggregate)
description: Team-level view only: no user or session labels. Per-member and per-session detail lives in Members & Sessions.

list.name: data_source
list.label: Data source
list.description: transcript: derived from local transcripts. real-otel: Claude Code's own OTel, which carries no data_source label (matches the empty label). all: both, which double counts a machine that exports both. The built-in All (URL value $__all, kept so old bookmarks work) is the same as all (may double count). The Budget dashboard always excludes synthetic and transcript-fixture, so those two options leave its panels empty.
list.query: transcript : transcript, real-otel : ^$, all (may double count) : .*, synthetic : synthetic, transcript-fixture : transcript-fixture

panels.title: Max context % of window by model
panels.description: Highest context size (input + cacheRead + cacheCreation) seen in the range, as a share of the window configured in config/model-windows.json. Fed by transcript data; real OTel has no window signal.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (model) (max_over_time(claude_code_context_utilization_ratio{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Sessions above 80% of window
panels.description: Number of sessions whose peak context exceeded 80% of the model window. Answered from Loki; session ids are never shown here. See the Members & Sessions dashboard for which sessions.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_pct != "" | unwrap context_pct [$__range]) by (session_id) > 0.8)

panels.title: Context drops in range
panels.description: Compaction detector: a main-thread request whose context fell below the configured ratio of the previous request in the same session. Heuristic: it cannot tell a compaction from a /clear-like reset.

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) * 0) * (last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) >= bool (last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) * 0))))

panels.title: Requests by context % of window
panels.description: Distribution of per-request context size against the model window. Most requests should sit in the lower buckets; a heavy right tail means long, unmanaged sessions.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_pct != "" | context_pct < 0.25 [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_pct != "" | context_pct >= 0.25 | context_pct < 0.5 [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_pct != "" | context_pct >= 0.5 | context_pct < 0.75 [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_pct != "" | context_pct >= 0.75 | context_pct < 0.9 [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_pct != "" | context_pct >= 0.9 [$__range]))

panels.title: Context size per request (p95, tokens)
panels.description: A comes from the transcript exporter. B derives the same size from the real api_request event fields input_tokens, cache_read_tokens and cache_creation_tokens; those names are unverified against real output, so B may stay empty. Each bar or point summarises the 24 hours ending at its timestamp (UTC). Loki labels a window by its end, so today's point is stamped at the next UTC midnight.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_tokens != "" | unwrap context_tokens [1d]) by (model)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | context_tokens = "" | label_format context_tokens=`{{ add (add (int .input_tokens) (int .cache_read_tokens)) (int .cache_creation_tokens) }}` | unwrap context_tokens [1d]) by (model)

sum by (model) ((last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[1d] offset -1d) - (last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d]) or last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[1d] offset -1d) * 0) * (last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[1d] offset -1d) >= bool (last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d]) or last_over_time(claude_code_context_drop_count_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[1d] offset -1d) * 0))))

sort_desc(sum by (decision, source) ((last_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) * 0) * (last_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) >= bool (last_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[400d] offset $__range) or last_over_time(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{data_source=~"$data_source"}[$__range]) * 0)))))

panels.title: MCP calls over time

panels.description: Each bar or point summarises the 24 hours ending at its timestamp (UTC). Loki labels a window by its end, so today's point is stamped at the next UTC midnight.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "tool_result" | data_source =~ "$data_source" [$__range]))

avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "tool_result" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | label_format failed=`{{ if eq .success "false" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap failed [$__range]) by (tool_name)

panels.title: Bash command classes
panels.description: First token of each Bash command, allowlisted by the exporter (anything else is bucketed as other). Command text and arguments are never exported. Real OTel does not emit command_class, so this is transcript data only.

targets.expr: sum by (command_class) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "tool_result" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | tool_name = "Bash" | command_class != "" [$__range]))

avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "tool_result" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | tool_name = "Bash" | command_class != "" | label_format failed=`{{ if eq .success "false" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap failed [$__range]) by (command_class)

panels.title: API requests by model
panels.description: Requests, failed requests, retries and p95 latency per model. Transcript errors take the model of the preceding request in the same thread; errors before any request in the thread appear under unknown. Latency is wall time between transcript records. Real OTel api_error events are counted as failures; their field names are unverified.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" [$__range]))
sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_error" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | outcome != "retry" [$__range]))
sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_error" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | outcome = "retry" [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | duration_ms != "" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (model)

panels.title: API latency by model (p95 ms)

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_request" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | duration_ms != "" | unwrap duration_ms [1d]) by (model)

panels.description: Each bar or point summarises the 24 hours ending at its timestamp (UTC). Loki labels a window by its end, so today's point is stamped at the next UTC midnight.

panels.title: API errors and retries over time

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name = "api_error" | data_source =~ "$data_source" | label_format outcome=`{{ if .outcome }}{{ .outcome }}{{ else }}failed{{ end }}` [1d]))
